summary: Iteration 2 additions fully verified. Backend: 25/25 new pytest tests PASS (56/56 total including iter1 regression). Verified endpoints: GET /api/featured-stylist (approved+unlimited only, deterministic ISO-week rotation, no phone), booking `code` generation (6-char alphanumeric excluding 0/O/1/I, unique across bookings), POST /api/bookings/check-in-by-code (200 on own code, 404 wrong code, 403 non-owner), legacy POST /api/bookings/{id}/check-in still works, POST/GET /api/hairdressers/me/(submit-)verification with SLA overdue flag + days_left_sla, /api/hairstyles/{id}/hairdressers and /api/search exclude pending pros, POST /api/bookings against non-approved pro returns 400, GET /api/admin/verifications admin-gated (403 for non-admin) with overdue flag + status filter, POST /api/admin/verifications/{hid}/decide updates status/decided_at/reason and creates notification, phone privacy — /auth/me returns caller's own phone, hairdresser detail/search/hairstyle-pros/booking response never leak phone, RegisterIn schema rejects role=admin with 422, seed idempotent with admin@braids.demo and pending Simone. Frontend: All 9 iter2 UI flows PASS — Home featured stylist card visible above hero and tappable to profile, portfolio grid tap opens full-screen /viewer with close button, Booking detail shows 6-char code prominently, My Bookings shows `#CODE` pill on confirmed upcoming bookings (verified pill '#U3PGWG'), 'Check-in with my code' button works (status→checked_in), 'Check-in with entered code' + wrong-code error 'Invalid code' displayed correctly, new pro registration correctly routes to /pro/verification with 'Under review — typically completed within 3 business days' PENDING banner, Admin login routes to /admin/verifications, pending/approved/rejected tabs work, Simone shown with 'SLA OVERDUE' + red border, Approve/Reject buttons + rejection-reason input present. Subscription plan toggle remains MOCKED per spec. License upload is URL/base64 string only — no file-storage integration (documented mocked behavior).
action_items: No fixes required — all iter2 features work as specified.
(Cosmetic, unchanged from iter1) Bottom tab bar buttons still have no testID — use text selectors (Discover/Search/Bookings/Profile). Recommend adding tab-* testIDs for tighter automation.
(Cosmetic) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RN internal warning, low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~880 lines — still monolithic. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, bookings, hairdressers, admin, verification, portfolio) once past MVP.
gen_code retry loop only tries 5 times on collision — safe for MVP scale but consider adding a unique index on bookings.code for stronger uniqueness guarantee.

admin_list_verifications uses `status_: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias='status')` — good pattern. Consider validating status_ ∈ {'pending','approved','rejected'} to prevent arbitrary string filters.
check_in_by_code accepts code lowercase→UPPER but does not restrict to allowed alphabet — minor: could reject clearly invalid input before DB query.
verification_license_url has no size/type validation (accepts arbitrary string / URL / base64) — acceptable for MVP but should be validated when file-storage integration is added.
Phone privacy enforcement is correct at every response path we tested; verified by explicit 'phone' key absence assertions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for iter2 flows tested (featured stylist, viewer, booking code UI, check-in-by-code UI incl. wrong-code error, admin routing/tabs/overdue highlight, pro registration→verification banner)

seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded demo data (admin@braids.demo, sara@braids.demo, amara/zara/kenya/simone@braids.demo). All ad-hoc test users prefixed 'test_' with @example.com domain. Bookings created during tests were cancelled/checked-in cleanly.
